opening_annotation.strategic_intent: The opening aims for a quick expansion while teching to zergling movement speed, enabling aggressive map control and harassment with speedlings, while maintaining a defensive queen.
supporting_facts: The opening has a high winrate of 55.95% across 3605 games.

The distinctive flags show high rates for first gas (99.86%), first production (100%), first combat unit (99.00%), and first upgrade (92.65%) compared to baselines, indicating a fast and aggressive build order.
The medoid key sequence starts with Spawning Pool, then Gas, then Base (expansion), followed by a queen and zergling movement speed upgrade, confirming the fast expand into speedling tech.
The profile shows high investment in economy (43.88%) and ground (31.53%), with no air or technology investment, consistent with a ground-based speedling timing.
